name: @luzir/bolota
description: Deterministic avatars from any string, with a live animation engine. No dependencies.
//sideEffects: Not `false`. That would license bundlers to drop `import "@luzir/bolota/motion.css"` as dead weight, and animated bolotas would silently render static for everyone shipping through a bundler.
//exports: Compiled package: `exports` resolves every subpath to `dist` (see `scripts/build.ts`). `main`/`types` above are the pre-`exports`-map fallback for older resolvers, pointed at the same compiled entry. `src` is not part of what ships (see `files` below) — it is source for this repo, not for a consumer's install.

scripts.//golden: Regenerating is a deliberate act, so the script refuses without `--write` and says why. `check` does not call it — `bun test` already asserts against the fixture, which is the direction that matters.
scripts.check: bun test && bun run size && bun run build
scripts.//prepare: Runs on `bun add git+...`/`npm install <git-url>` for a git dependency, where there is no publish step and therefore no `prepack` — this is what gives a git-dep consumer a `dist` at all. Also fires on `bun install`/`npm install` in a clone of this repo itself (harmless: `bun test` and every other script read `src` directly, never `dist`).

author: Adam Ousmer
